gen-gf-sniglet-gf-antic: Soft, stubby display shapes with terminals that stop short of curling back in, led by Sniglet. Antic follows with open mouths and a single-nib look, content to be the quiet one.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ar-one-sans: Distinctive, this Sniglet heading, with curves and stems in lockstep. AR One Sans takes over below as a plain sans with brush ends lifting away before each curve closes, so a long passage moves along lightly and without fuss.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-assistant: Chunky and hairline-free, Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back in and holds one level beat throughout. Assistant keeps its mouths open on c, e and a, so extended text stays easy.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree is an approachable sans-serif with light, unpinched round letters and no thick-and-thin modulation at all. Sniglet above it brings the commanding display shapes, and a modest body size lets that gap show.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-barlow: Approachable, that is Barlow, with c shapes pulled well apart and strokes like neon tube. Sniglet's stubby display heading sits above it, so a longer passage in Barlow reads as steady, friendly sans-serif text.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic reads wide and spacious, with a generous channel into every bowl. Sniglet supplies the flat, contrast-free display heading, while BIZ UDGothic keeps a longer passage moving in sans that never feels crowded.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-biz-udpgothic: Flat, single-weight linework defines Sniglet, whose terminals stop short of curling back in. BIZ UDPGothic then spaces its letters lavishly, a plain sans with clear channels into round forms, so long text breathes easily.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-bpmf-huninn: Round, blunt and commanding up top. Sniglet takes the heading, while Bpmf Huninn, a sans with a single-weight outline feel and wide channels into each bowl, is best given a comfortable body size.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std is a sans-serif whose counters stay connected to the outside, with a restrained swell in curved strokes. Shrink Sniglet and its commanding shapes lose their force.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-cairo: Cairo opens a wide channel into every bowl, giving a modern sans body that feels orderly and professional. Sniglet's diagonals carry the same heft as its stems, and that sturdiness is the pair's strongest quality.
